reason: Terrain primarily analyzes codebases and generates synchronized engineering documentation and agent-ready project context, while also supporting environment setup and ACP-based development workflows.

summaries.zh: Terrain 用于分析代码仓库并生成架构文档、智能体上下文和配套开发环境配置。
summaries.en: Terrain analyzes code repositories and generates architecture documentation, agent-ready context, and supporting development environment configuration.

capabilities: Generates architecture documentation and structured agent context
Installs configured skills, CLIs, and AGENTS.md snippets into an engineering environment
Supports ACP agent workflows that may produce repository changes
